name: After § 99
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 99a. Strongly opposes the continuation of the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement between the EU and Cuba1a; considers that, in view of the Cuban regime’s complete failure to comply with its provisions, the scale of repression against the Cuban people and Havana’s strategic alliances with Moscow, Minsk, Beijing and Tehran, including actions directly undermining European security, the Agreement should be suspended immediately; stresses that the EU must unequivocally stand with the Cuban people and their aspirations for freedom and democracy, rather than with the communist regime that oppresses them; considers that the EU’s continued failure to do so further undermines its credibility on the international stage; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a OJ L 337 I, 13.12.2016, p. 3, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/agree\_internation/2016/2232/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/agree_internation/2016/2232/oj).
